meta.note: Historical rural survey. Agricultural-household measures exclude wage-only households; land/livestock tables also include all/non-agricultural rural households where labelled. meta.note: Historical rural survey. Agricultural-household measures exclude wage-only households; land/livestock tables also include all/non-agricultural rural households where labelled.
